title: Fungiviolet
body:
Description

Fungiviolet is an ore that can spawn in the Uncertainty Cave. It is characterized by its iconic particles. Unlike other ore, which appear as crystals in their stone nodes, this ore is a particle emitter. Fungiviolet can only spawn in Fungoidite

It's quite easy to spot since it has a white-like particle, rotating like a 2D image in a 3D world (to player's location) and the purple-ish light which glows around the ore.

It has a 3/500 or 0.6% chance of spawning.

Obtaining

To obtain Fungioviolet, players must mine the Fungoidite node with a pickaxe.
